audit.current_execution_model: sequential per source (run_etl_for_source loop in ExtractAgent)
audit.task_boundaries: source (extract->normalize->clean->promote as one pipeline; cross-file limit)
audit.input_output_flow: cache files -> extracted.jsonl -> normalized.jsonl -> cleaned.jsonl -> atlas_staging.jsonl + report.json
audit.parallel_opportunity: source-level fan-out (files within a source are not safely splittable due to limit semantics)

implementation.task_design: source-level tasks (Option A variant): one Task per source_id

task_shape.output_target: metadata/etl/<source_id>/*.jsonl (worker writes; report.json for resume reload)

implementation.worker: etl_task (module-level, picklable; raises on failed status for retry)
implementation.orchestrator: run_etl_scheduler(root, source_ids, ...) -> EtlResult dicts sorted by source_id
implementation.scheduler: adaptive workers, bounded submission, retry max_retries=2, lease 900s
implementation.fallback: sequential loop preserved on scheduler error (identical output)
implementation.unchanged: cleaners, converters, schema logic, validators, extractors, normalizer

resource_awareness.adaptive_workers: scheduler decides via safe_worker_limit() (RAM margin 0.8, CPU cores)
resource_awareness.memory: per-source processing streams through extract/normalize/clean; no full-corpus load
resource_awareness.disk_headroom: respected via scheduler design (disk threshold rule in architecture doc)
resource_awareness.duplicate_writes: avoided — completed sources skipped via registry; output written once per task

verification.determinism: extracted.jsonl + atlas_staging.jsonl SHA-256 identical; normalized/cleaned compared by record ids (created_at=utc_now pre-existing)
verification.resume: completed sources skipped on rerun (report.json reloaded); stale running re-claimed
verification.retry: failed source retried then completed; terminal after max_retries
verification.failure_recovery: source with no cached files -> failed dict, not a crash
verification.schema_preserved: EtlResult keys + output files unchanged; curated/raw-external untouched

platform_note.macos: SQLite fork segfault (Python 3.9) may fall back to sequential executor; output identical
